First step of track 10 milestone 1. Reads a snapshot of `prompts/runs.jsonl` (189 runs): cost fields are present in at most 1% of runs, about a third of listed projects are in follow-up families, 24 slugs appear in more than one run, and all 143 recorded CI-failure counts are zero. Preliminary: no git-history backfill, no value or correctness scoring. 8 stdlib tests pass and `python3 site/build.py` prints ok. Adds the `swe` theme colour, the README bullet, the projects.json entry and a run line.
